description: FIN-02 (val4): BETA.DIST cdf and density ladders at a = 1/2 (b = 1/2, 1, 3/2, 9/2, 5) on x = 1E-6*3^-n, n = 0,4,...,300,301,302,303 (the x column is a checked raw cell, so the kernel argument is known exactly), and 25 saturated inverse returns in both orientations. Purpose: bit-exact kernel models at shape 1/2 and tiny x, where the endpoint-saturation searches take about 303 one-third steps; the engine is 1E-13 to 5E-13 off on F.INV(1E-200,1,1), F.INV(1E-300,1,9), F.INV(1E-300,1,10) and F.INV.RT(1E-300,2,1). Hypothesis for the right-tail returns: F.INV.RT(p,d1,d2) = (d2/d1)*(1-s)/s mapped through the four-log sum, with s the saturated BETA.INV(p,d2/2,d1/2) (cached F.INV.RT(1E-300,3,1) = 1.2320245435514617E+150 and FINV(1E-200,9,1) = 4.1067731191132565E+149, gen-m9). Precision!B2:B4 must retain 0.9999999999999998, 1, 1.0000000000000002; C2:C4 must be -1,0,1. Predictions are hypotheses, NOT expected/oracle values. Protocol: docs/research/probe-request-val4-fin.md.
